title: RFP-EXT-01 Buyer extends an open RFP deadline by 7 days
precondition: Signed in as procurement manager. Market NL (feature flag deadlineExtension on). An open RFP exists.
steps:
1. Open the RFP
2. Enter 7 in 'Extend deadline by'
3. Click 'Extend deadline'
expected_result:
1. The RFP page shows the extension form under the deadline
2. -
3. A confirmation message shows the new date; the deadline is 7 days later than before

title: RFP-EXT-02 An extension outside 1 to 30 days is rejected
precondition: Signed in as procurement manager. Market NL. An open RFP exists.
steps:
1. Open the RFP
2. Extend the deadline by 0 days
3. Extend the deadline by 31 days
expected_result:
1. The extension form is visible
2. An error says to enter 1 to 30 days; the deadline is unchanged
3. The same error is shown; the deadline is unchanged

title: RFP-EXT-03 The extension is not offered where the feature is off
precondition: Signed in as procurement manager. Market BE (feature flag deadlineExtension off). An open RFP exists.
steps: 1. Open the RFP in market BE
expected_result: 1. The RFP page shows the deadline but no extension form

title: RFP-EXT-04 Vendor sees the extended deadline
precondition: An open RFP inviting the NL vendor login was extended by the buyer.
steps:
1. Sign in as vendor.nl@procurelab.test
2. Open My RFPs
expected_result:
1. -
2. The invitation shows the new deadline
